note: Hungary: EEA and Swiss nationals live and work freely (the eea list). A third-country national performer works on the Hungarian Card, a residence permit that entitles its holder to stay and work, open to a performing artist (Act XC of 2023, § 36, in force from 1 October 2026). Neither the act nor its implementing decree (Government Decree 35/2024, read the same day) names days a performer may work without it, so none are modelled.
